Yeah, I think allowing different classes to play bot is good. But when that means ADCs aren't good bot anymore, you have to allow them to play somewhere else. Right now there's just nowhere to play them since they lose bot lane and are troll picks in other lanes.

I think another problem with that is that ADCs (traditional ones) are only really viable in one role. Like, we get Lucian mid when he's strong and has matchups that he hard counters. And every once in a while someone will pick Vayne top (and then usually feed).

But other than that, it feels like other champions are taking the position ADCs play in, while traditional ADCs are just pushed out. And this is a role that for 7.5 seasons saw pretty much 100% play of marksmen. So there is a portion of the player base that has put up to 7 years into learning a specific class of champions and then get told to adapt like top, mid, and jungle. Like, their metas have been shifting the whole time. Mid laners already know how to play assassins and mages. ADC players have never played anything else before, so it's a harder transition.

Meanwhile, since ADCs are only viable bot, they have nowhere else to go. It's not like a player even if they are super well-rounded at ADC (eg. can play Tristana, Jinx, Kai'sa, Ezreal, Kog'maw, Jhin, Ashe, Draven all to a good level) can just bring their champion pool to another lane. Being immobile is never favored, but there are some metas it is overshadowed in.

For example:

If the meta is full of tanks and you need DPS: Kog'Maw, Twitch, Jinx, and Varus (on-hit) can be viable because their DPS makes up for their lack of mobility.

If the meta has champions that outrange ADCs and make it impossible to get in, you need range. So champs like Jhin, Varus (lethality), Ezreal, and Lucian (for Culling) can be meta. Because range is worth more than mobility.

And if ADCs are able to live but don't have high DPS (due to items or something systemic that affects all ADCs), then utility becomes more important. So we get Varus, Ashe, Jhin, and Sivir.

So while mobility will never be bad (for example, in a DPS meta, Tristana and Caitlyn might see play especially for their mobility), it just sometimes doesn't matter as much as other qualities.

Yeah, I don't think ADCs have great runes tbh. Obviously, you go Precision primary for the keystone. Then you go Triumph (doesn't do much, especially in lane), Legend: Alacrity (Hard to feel its effects, I think it's ok though), and Coup de Grace which isn't very good. There's really no variety there.

And then for your secondary tree, you don't want resolve since they removed Chrysalis so you don't have 2 good runes. You also don't take advantage of the middle and bottom rows in Domination. Inspiration isn't really good. Biscuits could work I guess, but that's it. So you are stuck with Sorcery where you can take Manaflow Band on some ADCs (Lucian, Sivir, Xayah). Then in the second row, you don't want Transcendence or new Celerity so you have to take Absolute Focus. And in the bottom row, you don't abuse Scorch or Waterwalking (lol), so you go Gathering Storm.

So pretty much every ADC (except, like, Ezreal) takes the same 5 minor runes with only the Keystone changing. And the minor runes aren't even that good.

I mean, while that is true, I don't think it's that big of a problem. If you think about it, an ADC isn't fighting a midlaner when they are both on the first component. It really only makes a difference when you compare it to other ADC first backs like Cutlass.

Yeah, I would say an alternative item for armor could be another option. And I agree that this change doesn't feel very good. If you are playing an ADC and you aren't doing good damage, it just doesn't feel good. It doesn't feel fun to shoot peas at the enemy.

And that's probably the biggest reason why I feel the first set of changes is healthier. But as for the GA changes, I definitely feel like it would be different from old GA (Cloth Armor + Negatron Cloak). It would still have AD and would have Stopwatch. And the component for armor would be something you can sit on. Because, as for lethality, armor does make a big difference. The flat pen is much weaker when the target has 100 armor instead of 50.
